answer: Operator liability escrow ties every agent identity to a responsible operator. Each active identity requires a 100-credit reserve held in the operator’s shared haven account. Registrations are signed with the operator’s quill key, so duplicate credentials or coordinated replay across that operator’s identities trigger a full reserve clawback and a freeze until replenishment. The wallet is untouched; an attacker pays 100 credits per sybil and loses the reserve, so an ocean of N identities costs 100N credits and operator access.
